messages:
elena: Orion asked for a compact artifact + owner list for the upcoming power/throughput sweep. Can we confirm who brings images, kernels, telemetry, and the upload location? cc @priya @dan @lucas

priya: I got images. I will push runtime:2.8-orion and runtime:2.8-quant, publish digests, and provide a tarball for air-gapped load. Upload target: gs://redwood-orion/artifacts/$RUN_ID. ETA Tue noon.

dan: I will own kernel variants and perf counter list. Deliverables: kernel tarballs (stock, energy-sched) + build SHA file. I’ll also add a short perf counters README.

lucas: Telemetry & infra here. I will supply prometheus scrape config, an ipmi poll script for wall meter, and a small collector to merge nvidia-smi and ipmi. I’ll verify host SSH access with Orion.

elena: Good. Run matrix: models gptj + 7B-llama, seq 512/1536, batch 1/8, two modes (capped pstate, uncapped). Marcos? (cc omitted) Please no public numbers without partner signoff.

bench-bot: Created ticket ORN-8870: "Orion joint perf sweep - artifacts + runbook". Rack booked Thu 09:00-17:00.

priya: Small run snippet I’ll include:
```bash
export RUN_ID=ORION-2026-05-14-01
docker run --rm --gpus all -e RUN_ID -e SEQ=1536 -e BATCH=1 -v /results:/results ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.8-orion ./bench_runner.sh --model gptj
```
I’ll share image digests in the sheet.

dan: Postproc plan: simple script to compute tokens/sec, avg power (wall), and perf_per_watt. Will push to tools/bench/orion_postproc.py.

elena: Thanks — please upload artifacts and the matrix to gs://redwood-orion/$RUN_ID and set ACL for orion-team. I’ll draft the 1-page runbook and share by EOD Wed. No announcements until partner signoff. :white_check_mark:
